According to VirusTotal API v3, there's an endpoint: GET /objects/{object_id}/relationships/{relationship_type}. For domains, the object ID would be something like "domain/example.org". So we need to call GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/objects/domain/example.org/relationships/subdomains?limit=10&continuation_cursor=abc. We need to include the API key in the header: x-apikey: my_api.
